rules_findings.evidence: Our [family checkups and cleanings](/services/family-checkups) include exams and cleanings for every age in on
rules_findings.message: Statistic or study claim with no source link in the paragraph.

findings.quote: Yes, the whole family can book on the same day. Call us and ask for appointments together.
findings.why: The ficha says same-day family booking is only "Often, yes" and that the front desk will look for back-to-back times, so the post's unconditional "Yes" overstates what the clinic offers.
findings.fix: Change to "Often, yes. Tell our front desk how many people you are booking and we will look for back-to-back times."

findings.quote: Yes. Call (512) 555-0176 and ask for appointments on the same day for everyone in your family. Dr. Priya Raman sees adults and Dr. Tomas Alvarez sees children.
findings.why: This FAQ answer repeats the unconditional same-day promise from the ficha's conditional "Often, yes" wording, and it appears in the front matter, the visible FAQ and the FAQPage JSON-LD.
findings.fix: Replace with the ficha wording ("Often, yes" plus back-to-back scheduling on request) in the front matter, the visible FAQ and the FAQPage JSON-LD so they match.

findings.quote: Cavities do not heal on their own, and a spot between your teeth can grow without much warning
findings.why: This is an oversimplification: early enamel lesions can remineralize with fluoride, while cavities that have reached dentin do not heal on their own, so the absolute wording overstates the case.
findings.fix: Say "Cavities that have reached the tooth's inner layers do not heal on their own; your dentist can tell whether a spot needs treatment or can be monitored."

findings.quote: Dr. Priya Raman sees adults and Dr. Tomas Alvarez sees children.
findings.why: The ficha assigns Dr. Raman general, restorative and emergency care and Dr. Alvarez children's dentistry, but it does not say Dr. Raman sees only adults.
findings.fix: Use the ficha's own wording, for example "Dr. Priya Raman provides general and restorative care and Dr. Tomas Alvarez focuses on children's dentistry."
